Learn more about privacy protocols Sintra.ai Integrations - Frequently Asked Questions What is the full Sintra.ai integrations list? The current Sintra.ai integrations list includes: Gmail, Microsoft Outlook, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, Google Calendar, Google Drive, Google Analytics, Notion, QuickBooks, and Strava - with more being added regularly. Each integration connects directly to the specialist role that uses it most: Gmail and Outlook go to your email marketer, Google Analytics to your data analyst, and so on. Do I need technical skills to set up Sintra Integrations? None at all. Setting up Sintra.ai integrations takes about 2 minutes per tool - you authenticate your account, select which specialist connects to it, and you're done. No coding, no webhooks, no developer needed. How do Sintra.ai integrations work with my existing tools? Once connected, each Sintra specialist accesses your tool directly to read, write, or send - depending on what the task requires. Your email marketer uses Gmail to send campaigns; your data analyst pulls from Google Analytics for reports. Everything works inside your existing stack, and you stay in control of what each specialist can access. What happens if I face issues with my integrations? Our support team is available via email and live chat to help you troubleshoot any Sintra.ai integration issue. Most integration problems are resolved within a few hours. You can also find step-by-step setup guides for every integration in our Help Center. Can I add new integrations to Sintra.ai in the future? Yes - Sintra.ai integrations expand regularly. You can connect all available tools from day one with no limit, and new integrations are added based on user demand. If there's a tool you rely on that isn't listed yet, you can request it directly from your dashboard. Want a welcome gift? Sent! Look in your inbox Oops! Something went wrong, try again.
